text: Pak-o-shaffaf auraq ki zeenat Quran-e-Hakim: Ahl-e-Kitab se murad Yahood-o-Nasara hain aur Mushrikeen se murad but poojne wale Arab aur aatish parast Ajami hain. Farmata hai ke yeh log baghair daleel hasil kiye baaz rehne wale na thay. Phir bataya ke woh daleel Allah ke Rasool Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jo pak sahifay yani Quran-e-Kareem parh sunate hain jo aala farishton ne pak auraq mein likha hua hai, jaise aur jagah hai "Fi suhufin mukarramah" (80:13) al-kh, ke woh nami girami, buland-o-bala, pak saaf auraq mein, pak-baaz, neko-kar buzurg farishton ke hathon likhay huay hain. Phir farmaya ke in pak sahifon mein Allah ki likhi hui baatein adl-o-istiqamat wali majood hain, jin ke Allah ki janib se honay mein koi shak-o-shuba nahin, na in mein koi khata aur ghalti hui hai. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) farmate hain ke woh Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) umdagi ke sath Qurani wa'z kehte hain aur is ki achi tareefain bayan karte hain. Ibn-e-Zaid (R.H) farmate hain in sahifon mein kitabein hain, istiqamat aur adl-o-insaf wali. Phir farmaya ke agli kitabon wale Allah ki hujjatain qaim ho chukne aur daleelain panay ke baad Allah ke kalam ke matalib mein ikhtilaf karne lagay aur juda juda rahon mein bat gaye, jaise ke is hadith mein hai jo mukhtalif tareeqon se marwi hai ke Yahudiyon ke ikhattar (71) firqay ho gaye aur Nasraniyon ke bahattar (72) aur is ummat ke tehattar (73) firqay ho jayenge, so ek ke sab jahannam mein jayenge. Logon ne poocha woh ek kaun hai? Farmaya woh jo is par ho jis par main aur mere as-hab hain. Phir farmaya ke unhein sirf itna hi hukum tha ke khuloos aur ikhlas ke sath sirf apne sachay Mabood ki ibadat mein lagay rahein, jaise aur jagah (Wama arsalna min qablika mir-rasulin illa noohi ilaihi annahu la ilaha illa ana fa'budoon) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 25), yani tujh se pehle bhi hum ne jitne Rasool bheje sab ki taraf yahi wahi ki ke mere siwa koi Mabood-e-Barhaq nahin, tum sab sirf meri hi ibadat karte raho. Isi liye yahan bhi farmaya ke yaksu ho kar yani shirk se door aur tauheed mein mashghool ho kar, jaise aur jagah hai (Walaqad ba'athna fi kulli ummatir-rasoolan ani'budullaha wajtanibut-taghoot) (Surah An-Nahl: 36), yani hum ne har ummat mein Rasool bheja ke Allah ki ibadat karo aur Allah ke siwa dusron ki ibadat se bacho. Hanif ki poori tafseer Surah An'am mein guzar chuki hai jisay lautane ki ab zaroorat nahin. Phir farmaya namazon ko qaim karein jo ke badan ki tamam ibadaton mein sab se aala ibadat hai aur Zakat dete rahein yani faqiron aur mohtajon ke sath sulook karte rahein. Yahi deen mazboot, seedha, durust, adl wala aur umdagi wala ho. Bahut se Aimma-e-Kiram ne jaise Imam Zuhri (R.H), Imam Shafi'i (R.H), waghaira ne is ayat se is amr par istidlal kiya hai ke a'maal iman mein dakhil hain, kyunke in ayaton mein Allah Ta'ala ki khuloos aur yaksu'i ke sath ki ibadat aur namaz-o-zakat ko deen farmaya gaya hai.

Saari makhlooq se behtar aur badtar kaun hai? Allah Ta'ala kafiron ka anjam bayan farmata hai, woh kafir khwah Yahood-o-Nasara hon ya mushrikeen-e-Arab-o-Ajam hon, jo bhi Anbiya-e-Allah ke mukhalif hon aur Kitabullah ke jhutlane wale hon, woh Qayamat ke din Jahannam ki aag mein daal diye jayenge aur isi mein pade rahenge, na wahan se niklenge na raha honge. Yeh log tamam makhlooq se badtar aur kamtar hain. Phir apne nek bandon ke anjam ki khabar deta hai, jin ke dilon mein iman hai aur jo apne jismon se sunnat ki baja-awari mein har waqt masroof rehte hain, ke yeh saari makhlooq se behtar aur buzurg hain. Is ayat se Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) aur ulama-e-kiram ki ek jamaat ne istidlal kiya hai ke iman wale insan farishton se bhi afzal hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke un ka nek badla un ke Rab ke paas un lazawal jannaton ki surat mein hai jin ke chappe chappe par paak saaf pani ki nehren beh rahi hain, jin mein dawam aur hamesha ki zindagi ke sath rahenge, na wahan se nikale jayen, na woh ne'matein un se juda hon, na kam hon, na aur koi khatka hai na gham. Phir in sab se badh chadh kar ne'mat-o-rahmat yeh hai ke raza-e-Rab, marzi-e-Maula unhein hasil ho gayi hai aur unhein is qadar ne'matein Janab-e-Bari ne ata farmayi hain ke yeh bhi dil se raazi ho gaye hain. Phir irshad farmata hai ke yeh behtareen badla, yeh bahut badi jaza, yeh ajr-e-azeem duniya mein Allah se darte rehne ka ewaz hai. Har woh shakhs jis ke dil mein dar ho, jis ki ibadat mein ikhlas ho, jo janta ho ke Allah ki us par nazrein hain, balkay ibadat ke waqt is mashghooli aur dilchaspi se ibadat kar raha ho ke goya khud woh apni aankhon se apne Khaliq, Malik, sachay Rab aur haqeeqi Allah ko dekh raha hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Main tumhein bataun ke sab se behtar shakhs kaun hai? Logon ne kaha zaroor. Farmaya: Woh shakhs jo apne ghore ki lagam thame hue hai ke kab jihad ki awaz buland ho aur kab main kood kar us ki peeth par sawar ho jaun aur garajta hua dushman ki fauj mein ghusun aur dad-e-shuja'at dun. Lo main tumhein ek aur behtareen makhlooq ki khabar dun, woh shakhs jo apni bakriyon ke rewar mein hai, na namaz ko chorta hai na zakat se ji churata hai. Aao ab main badtareen makhlooq bataun, woh shakhs ke Allah ke naam se sawal kare aur phir na diya jaye. Surah Lam Yakun ki tafsir khatam hui, Allah Ta'ala ka shukr-o-ehsan hai.

Allah Ta'ala kafiron ka anjam bayan farmata hai, woh kafir khwah Yahood-o-Nasara hon ya mushrikeen-e-Arab-o-Ajam hon, jo bhi Anbiya-e-Allah ke mukhalif hon aur Kitabullah ke jhutlane wale hon, woh Qayamat ke din Jahannam ki aag mein daal diye jayenge aur isi mein pade rahenge, na wahan se niklenge na raha honge. Yeh log tamam makhlooq se badtar aur kamtar hain. Phir apne nek bandon ke anjam ki khabar deta hai, jin ke dilon mein iman hai aur jo apne jismon se sunnat ki baja-awari mein har waqt masroof rehte hain, ke yeh saari makhlooq se behtar aur buzurg hain. Is ayat se Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) aur ulama-e-kiram ki ek jamaat ne istidlal kiya hai ke iman wale insan farishton se bhi afzal hain. Phir irshad hota hai ke un ka nek badla un ke Rab ke paas un lazawal jannaton ki surat mein hai jin ke chappe chappe par paak saaf pani ki nehren beh rahi hain, jin mein dawam aur hamesha ki zindagi ke sath rahenge, na wahan se nikale jayen, na woh ne'matein un se juda hon, na kam hon, na aur koi khatka hai na gham. Phir in sab se badh chadh kar ne'mat-o-rahmat yeh hai ke raza-e-Rab, marzi-e-Maula unhein hasil ho gayi hai aur unhein is qadar ne'matein Janab-e-Bari ne ata farmayi hain ke yeh bhi dil se raazi ho gaye hain. Phir irshad farmata hai ke yeh behtareen badla, yeh bahut badi jaza, yeh ajr-e-azeem duniya mein Allah se darte rehne ka ewaz hai. Har woh shakhs jis ke dil mein dar ho, jis ki ibadat mein ikhlas ho, jo janta ho ke Allah ki us par nazrein hain, balkay ibadat ke waqt is mashghooli aur dilchaspi se ibadat kar raha ho ke goya khud woh apni aankhon se apne Khaliq, Malik, sachay Rab aur haqeeqi Allah ko dekh raha hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain: Main tumhein bataun ke sab se behtar shakhs kaun hai? Logon ne kaha zaroor. Farmaya: Woh shakhs jo apne ghore ki lagam thame hue hai ke kab jihad ki awaz buland ho aur kab main kood kar us ki peeth par sawar ho jaun aur garajta hua dushman ki fauj mein ghusun aur dad-e-shuja'at dun. Lo main tumhein ek aur behtareen makhlooq ki khabar dun, woh shakhs jo apni bakriyon ke rewar mein hai, na namaz ko chorta hai na zakat se ji churata hai. Aao ab main badtareen makhlooq bataun, woh shakhs ke Allah ke naam se sawal kare aur phir na diya jaye. Surah Lam Yakun ki tafsir khatam hui, Allah Ta'ala ka shukr-o-ehsan hai.
